commits.message:
feat(demos): themes-and-color-studio flagship — folds 4 demos, burns down 23 allowlist entries (rich-demos-l2x.3)

One non-interactive flagship demo replaces four overlapping ones
(rich-themes, rich-themes-transposed, rich-theme-designer, rich-colors).
[LAW:no-mode-explosion] [LAW:one-source-of-truth]

# Shape

Single file orchestrating eight sections as data, each exercising a layer
of the public API:

  1. Color values — ColorRgba, parseRgbHex/parseRgbaHex, blendRgb,
     compositeOver, ColorParseError.
  2. ColorSpec — factories (parse/fromAnsi/fromRgba/fromRgb/default),
     ColorDepth enum, downgrade across STANDARD_TABLE / EIGHT_BIT_TABLE /
     WINDOWS_TABLE, ANSI_COLOR_NAMES lookups.
  3. System detection — detectColorSystem with DetectColorOptions over
     four env fixtures, resolveColorSystem spec strings.
  4. Theme registry — listThemePalettes / getThemePalette /
     getThemeBaseColors walking every bundled theme, plus the raw
     THEMES / ThemePaletteData / ThemeName / ThemeBaseColors via the
     ./themes/data and ./themes/registry subpaths.
  5. PaletteResolver — bare / modifier / alpha / auto / composed specs
     against gruvbox; buildPalette + BaseColors to show derived
     primary-muted / text-primary / on-primary vars.
  6. TerminalTheme constants — all 23 bundled constants in one catalog
     row each (DEFAULT, SVG_EXPORT, MONOKAI, NORD, GRUVBOX, DRACULA,
     TOKYO_NIGHT, FLEXOKI, CYBERPUNK, CATPPUCCIN_*, SOLARIZED_*,
     ROSE_PINE*, ATOM_ONE_*, TEXTUAL_*).
  7. OKLCH transposition — Oklch / IDENTITY / INVERT_LIGHTNESS /
     isIdentityKey, transposePalette hue circle + chroma sweep + invert,
     themeKeyForRoot aiming a tonic at 200°, ANCHORED_ROOTS / isAnchored
     visibly locking error/success/warning hue.
  8. WCAG contrast — relativeLuminance / contrastRatio / contrastFor /
     ensureContrast across a gruvbox matrix plus three hard cases where
     ensureContrast slides L from <2:1 up to ≥4.5:1 while preserving hue.

[LAW:dataflow-not-control-flow] SECTIONS is the order; the orchestrator
loops over a function array. Section internals iterate data tables
(theme catalogs, spec lists, env fixtures) so adding a row never
requires editing logic.

[LAW:single-enforcer] bgFgStyle is the only place the demo flattens
alpha + applies ensureContrast(4.5). Every styled cell goes through it.

# Folded

- examples/rich-themes/                    (palette walk)
- examples/rich-themes-transposed/         (hue circle, chroma, invert)
- examples/rich-theme-designer/            (interactive picker)
- examples/rich-colors/                    (interactive color browser)

The interactive widget-based demos (theme-designer, colors) intentionally
do not get a TUI replacement here — their widget references belong to
widgets-playground (rich-demos-l2x.5) and the actual coverage they
provided for color/theme APIs is now satisfied non-interactively. The
flagship's spec contract was 'exercises every mapped API,' not 'preserves
every UX.' [feedback:no-legacy-code]

# Allowlist burn-down (23 entries → 0)

ANCHORED_ROOTS, BaseColors, ColorTable, DetectColorOptions,
EIGHT_BIT_TABLE, Oklch, ResolveContext, TEXTUAL_ANSI, TEXTUAL_DARK,
TEXTUAL_LIGHT, THEMES, ThemeBaseColors, ThemeName, ThemePaletteData,
buildPalette, detectColorSystem, getThemeBaseColors, isAnchored,
isIdentityKey, parseRgbaHex, relativeLuminance, resolveColorSystem,
themeKeyForRoot.

Verified via test/coverage/coverage.test.ts: removing the entries with
the demo in place leaves the verifier green; removing any one without a
matching reference would fail loudly.

# Test cleanup

test/examples/transpose-explore.test.ts is removed alongside its
demo — it tested the explorer's internal model (reduce, previewCells,
renderFrame, framesToSegments, appMock, renderShowcase), not the public
API. [LAW:behavior-not-structure] Public-API behavior is covered by
test/themes/transpose.test.ts, test/themes/colorMath.test.ts, and
test/core/oklch.test.ts.

# npm script

  npm run themes-and-color-studio                # terminal
  EXPORT_HTML=out.html npm run themes-and-color-studio  # +HTML export

Old scripts removed: colors, theme-designer, themes, themes:transposed,
themes:explore.

Closes rich-demos-l2x.3.

docs(spec): flagship demo set + every-export→flagship map (rich-demos-l2x.2) (#33)

* docs(spec): flagship demo set + every-export→flagship map (rich-demos-l2x.2)

Adds spec/demos.md — the single source of truth that the five flagship
build tickets (rich-demos-l2x.3 through .7) read in fresh /next sessions.
[LAW:one-source-of-truth]

Design:
- Five flagships keyed by the canonical kebab-case names already in the
  `Flagship` type at test/coverage/coverage-allowlist.ts:
  themes-and-color-studio, renderables-gallery, widgets-playground,
  markup-and-text-lab, live-progress-console.
- Ownership rule: by source module. Each src/ module is owned by exactly
  one flagship; every export from that module belongs to that flagship.
  [LAW:types-are-the-program] — turns per-export ownership from a
  judgment call into a mechanical lookup.
- Folding plan for every existing demo. claude-sessions and rich-explore
  are deleted (TUI apps whose patterns are reused inside
  renderables-gallery) so examples/ contains only the five flagships per
  the parent epic's mandate. [LAW:no-mode-explosion]

Verified mechanically against the verifier's export universe and the
allowlist's existing flagship tagging:
- 267 canonical public exports, each appears in exactly one flagship
  section (0 missing, 0 duplicates).
- All 120 burndown allowlist entries match their flagship section.
- npm run lint clean; coverage.test.ts green.

Build tickets l2x.3-l2x.7 already point at spec/demos.md with explicit
'do not infer scope from this ticket' wording — no retitle/re-split
needed since the canonical flagship names match the proposed grouping
in the parent epic verbatim.

* docs(spec): address PR-33 review — canonicalize flagship references

Three Copilot findings + one related drift, all the same shape: the
spec carried WHAT-claims (canonical name, count) that mirrored
coverage-allowlist.ts and had drifted from it. [LAW:one-source-of-truth]

- escapeMarkup parenthetical was directionally ambiguous ("re-exposed as
  `escape`'s public name" reads as if escapeMarkup is the alias).
  Reworded to "(the public name of `escape` from `core/markup`)" so
  the direction of the rename is unambiguous.

- Deletions table used the short form "themes-and-color" for the
  destination flagship in four rows. Replaced with the canonical
  "themes-and-color-studio" (matches the `Flagship` type in
  coverage-allowlist.ts) and widened the Fate column to fit.

- Two npm-script names were short-form (`themes-studio`,
  `markup-text-lab`). Normalized to match canonical flagship names
  exactly (`themes-and-color-studio`, `markup-and-text-lab`) so every
  flagship reference in the spec uses the same kebab string.

- All five "Allowlist burn-down: currently N entries" snapshots
  removed. The count was a divergent copy of the allowlist file's
  block size that drifts as build tickets burn entries down (Copilot
  found one already off by one: widgets-playground was 27, not 26).
  Replaced with stable pointers ("remove every burndown entry tagged
  `<flagship>` — i.e. the block under the `// -- <Header> --` header
  in coverage-allowlist.ts") so the spec no longer mirrors a number
  that changes. [LAW:comments-explain-why-only]

267-export cross-check still 0 missing / 0 duplicates; allowlist
cross-check still 0 mismatched. npm run lint clean;
coverage.test.ts green.

* docs(spec): align live-progress-console surfaces with actual Console API

Copilot caught a load-bearing-false claim: the spec said
live-progress-console owned an 'export-svg' Console surface, but
src/core/console.ts only has exportText/exportHtml/saveText/saveHtml
— there is no exportSvg/saveSvg method. [LAW:one-source-of-truth]
[LAW:verifiable-goals]

Replaced the made-up surface list with the actual Console methods:
recording (record option), exportText/exportHtml, saveText/saveHtml,
the logging entry points (log, print), and file-stream output via
ConsoleOptions.file. Each verified against console.ts grep before
claiming.

SVG_EXPORT_THEME (the palette data) is unaffected — that's owned by
themes-and-color-studio. SVG-export the verb simply doesn't exist on
Console.
